As fontes são distribuídas para uso do editor local. A licença SIL OFL 1.1
aplica-se às famílias abaixo, com as autorias indicadas nos binários e nas fontes.
O texto da licença está em OFL-Liberation-Sans-2.1.5.txt.

Assistant: The Assistant Project Authors (2020) e The Source Sans Pro Authors (2010).
https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/assistant
Cascadia Code: Microsoft Corporation (2020). https://github.com/microsoft/cascadia-code
Excalifont: Excalidraw (2024), Your Own Font Foundry e Ján Filípek / DizajnDesign.
https://plus.excalidraw.com/excalifont
Liberation Sans 2.1.5: Red Hat e demais autorias no arquivo de licença.
https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts/tree/2.1.5
Arquivo TTF sem modificação, extraído do pacote Debian fonts-liberation2 2.1.5-1.
https://deb.debian.org/debian/pool/main/f/fonts-liberation2/fonts-liberation2_2.1.5-1_all.deb
Lilita One: Juan Montoreano (2011). https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/lilitaone
Nunito: The Nunito Project Authors (2014). https://github.com/googlefonts/nunito
Virgil: Your Own Font Foundry (2011). https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/tree/v0.18.1/packages/excalidraw/fonts/Virgil
Xiaolai: LXGW (2020). https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/tree/v0.18.1/packages/excalidraw/fonts/Xiaolai

Comic Shanns usa a licença MIT, em MIT-ComicShanns.txt.
